geometry.mask_method: Replay selected RGBA alpha crop and INTER_AREA placement from original compositor receipt. All edits bounded by source alpha or local supporting-foot shadow.

deterministic_recipe.detail_softening: 22% blend with sigma=0.65 Gaussian; actor pixels only
deterministic_recipe.edge_reduction: 4 intensity levels on one-pixel alpha boundary
deterministic_recipe.contact_shadow: 15% peak attenuation at (522,755), sigma (28,3.3), existing support only

generative_recipe.normalization: LANCZOS to original delivery canvas, then bounded blend; no global color grading or geometric warping
generative_recipe.protected_face: Original central eyes/muzzle/smile pixels preserved through feathered face mask
generative_recipe.limitations: Generated interior wool/shading can drift; preserved edit support does not prove anatomical or identity match. Raw generator changes scenery, which is excluded from the bounded candidate. No new owner/technical approval inferred.
